what: a bracelet made of one length of black fiddle string, drawn thick and bold: a closed round loop of glossy black cord as thick as a finger, a perfect circle exactly as wide as it is tall, with a clear round hole through the middle. At the top of the loop the string is tied in one big endless knot, a flat square knot of the string woven over and under itself in a lattice, with no loose ends anywhere, as wide as a third of the loop. The string is glossy black like varnished gut, with bright pale grey glints along every curve and every crossing of the knot so its shape is plain.
colours: Glossy black string with bright pale silver-grey glints along every curve and crossing; the hole in the middle is the backdrop.
pose: Seen from the front, the loop standing upright like the letter O with the hole plainly showing and the endless knot at the top, as if hung in the air.
must_show: one round loop of thick black string with a clear hole
one big woven knot at the top, no loose ends
pale glints so the black shape reads

what: an old lamplighter's flask of lamp oil: one flat round flask of dull tin, shaped like a pilgrim's flask, a fat round disc of metal as thick as a third of its width, standing on its edge, with a short narrow neck at the top stopped with a dark brown cork. From one shoulder of the flask to the other runs one short loop of thick dark brown leather strap, arching over the neck. Its broad flat front is a flat blank surface, nothing carved, nothing on it: plain old tin covered in fine pale scratches, with a raised seam running all round its rim, lumpy with solder. It is battered out of true: its round outline is bent flat in one place on the lower left, and one long crease runs across the tin. A dark greasy stain of oil runs down from the neck over one shoulder.
colours: Dull mid-grey tin, darker than white, colourless, with pale grey scratches and highlights, darker grey shading in the dents; dark brown cork and leather strap; a darker brown-grey oil stain.
pose: Seen from the front and a little to one side, standing upright, the neck at the top, as if hung in the air.
must_show: one flat round tin flask with a short neck and cork
battered: bent outline and scratches; plain blank front
a leather strap loop over the top
must_not_show: canteen with a cover of cloth

what: Roland's great war horn, carved from one elephant's tusk: one long single horn in the shape of a crescent moon, in one bold arc, a natural horn with no metal valves. At its left end it is narrow and cut off flat, finished with a short open gold mouthpiece ring that a man could put his lips to; from there it widens smoothly all along the arc to a broad round open bell at its right end, whose inside is dark. Neither end is pointed. The ivory is old cream-white, polished, with fine carving of interlaced vines in low relief along it. It is bound by three broad bands of bright yellow gold, evenly spaced: one just behind the mouthpiece, one round the middle, and one wide band round the rim of the bell. Near the narrow mouthpiece end, between the mouthpiece and the first band, one dark jagged crack runs along the ivory, a bold black line as long as a quarter of the horn.
colours: Old cream-white ivory with warm grey shadows and darker grey in the carving; a gold mouthpiece and three broad bands of bright yellow gold, no silver; one black crack near the narrow end; the bell's inside dark brown-black.
pose: Lying on its side in one bold arc like a smile, the narrow mouthpiece at the left and the wide open bell at the right, both ends at the same height, the curve bowing downward, the whole horn inside the picture.
must_show: one long curved ivory horn, narrow open mouthpiece to wide open bell
a dark crack near the narrow mouthpiece end

what: a small healing remedy from an old story: a fish's gall, a small soft sac, wrapped in one broad fresh green leaf folded round it like a small parcel, lying on its side, longer than it is tall. The leaf is deep emerald-green with a pale midrib and pale veins, its tip folded over the top, and one end of the parcel is left open where the gall shows: a small glossy sac of dark bottle-green, darker than the leaf, smooth and wet with a white glint. Round the middle of the parcel is tied a twist of dry pale straw-yellow grass, wound twice and knotted, with two short stiff ends sticking out.
colours: Deep emerald-green leaf with pale yellow-green veins; the gall glossy dark bottle-green with a white glint; a twist of dry pale straw-yellow grass.
pose: Lying on its side, the open end with the gall at the right, seen from the front and a little above, as if hung in the air.
must_show: one small parcel of a green leaf
a twist of dry grass tied round it
a small dark glossy sac showing at one end
